reviews.review_description: The sales process was great, the installation was delayed because despite taking our money for a Powerwall 3, they had never installed one and they were not yet approved for Victoria. After a few months delay it was all good. The electricians were great and the installation went smoothly. But then the submission of the electrical works Request and post-installation form (DER) to Ausnet is still not complete EIGHT MONTHS LATER. So no feed in tariff and lots of emails from Ausnet threatening to cancel our contract (whatever that means). Numerous emails and phone called to 1Komma5 and still not resolved. I really want to like this company but my patience is wearing thin.
Everything was well explained. Happy with quality of the system. Too early to tell about after sales service yet.
The installers were punctual, polite, and cleaned up afterwards. Very professional.

Sales and quoting were easy, as long as you supply the pictures they ask for you will get a quote very quickly.We had 13.2kw of solar and two Powerwall 3s installed. The installation itself was great. As you can see from the pictures attached to this review the finished product was very clean and tidy.We are still waiting on the inspection so cannot review the performance of the system but everything thus far has been excellent.

The first time the battery kicked in after a short outage, our coffee machine kept setting off the overload switch, they blame the "outage" as the cause and refuse to do anything about the near new coffee machine. They are quite slow to call back when called, and state they are open from 8am. That is QLD time, so in NSW it is 9 am before you can communicate. So, watch your step with these suppliers as things may be not quite what they seem.

The sales process was smooth and completeInstallation team arrived on time and worked tirelessly over two days to set up the system.Now awaiting the Inspector for finalisation which has been organised by 1Komma5.

True warranty horror story - Be afraid of these guysI purchased a 10k solar setup and tesla powerwall 2 7 to 8 years ago.Firstly they installed the solar 7 months later the battery.Big wait times.On install they damaged my roof tiles in 2 place cause water damage to the house.That cost me alot to fix.Nice !!The system worked well for about 2 years saving me a fortune before the battery packed it.They then removed it and I waited another 6 months for replacement.After this it worked well except that about once or twice a week (during summer) it would throw the earth leakage breaker causing all the power to go off.I was told you need to have an electrician look at it, not their problem.Which brings us to about a year ago when the battery stopped working altogether.After dealing with Solaray and now 1komma5, they don't even talk to you, you follow their lodge tickets online and eventually get shunted to a Phillipines call centre who can't help you.I was ignored time and time again.I contacted Tesla who say your installer needs to look at it.The installer call centre kept trying to make me run reboots and wifi setups for 6 months before I got Tesla to pressure them to sent a technician out.Even Tesla said we can see from our end that it's not working and they sent me screen shots of their data to send to the installer (who also has access to the same info already.)When the technician finally came out - he asked me why he was here. He was not even informed of the case progress and after several hours he said - everything is installed properly there's no issue,except your battery is not connecting.I'm like I've been telling you guys this for 1 year already.I said what happens next, he said we will put everything in the report to the installer.I have never heard from them again.They will not respond to emails or phone calls.These are the exact cowboys that will rip you off and not honour the warranty!Btw Tesla also will not honour the warranty - it needs to be done by your installer they say, even though their product is faulty/Stay away from both.PS - Solaray now 1komma5 was an installer recommended from this sites 3 quotes.I had tried to do all I could to pick the right ppl and right gear.Very disappointed - my last winter powerbill was $1250 even having 10k solar.I'm now faced with replacing the whole lot- lucky it has paid for itself 2 years ago.But now I should be enjoying 7 odd years of savings and I'm not!

Had a couple of issues-one was confusion over inverter quotation-later resolved.Also a lack of discussion on inverter options.Later unhappy that deposit was okay on Paypal but remainder owing had to be cash or telephone credit card.Installation went well and performance seems great.

I’ve had a Solaredge inverter and one of their batteries since 2022 it has worked perfectly since installation. Adding a second SolarEdge battery should have been straightforward I thought….Of three installers, 1komma5 were by far the most responsive and offered the best price. They were quick to arrange the install and evaluate the best position.It was a little disquieting to hear the first sub-contractor hadn’t done a SolarEdge battery install before and the left without saying goodbye or how the installation had gone. I looked at my SolarEdge and saw the 2 batteries and thought all was well. That night I paid the final payment.A couple of days passed and I realised that my Amber and SolarEdge apps wasn’t seeing any production. The next week a second subcontractor came out and spent a morning trying to make the system work.Another week and SolarEdge advised the inverter needed to be replaced which would be  done under warranty. This was done by a third subcontractor and after 6 hours the system which had worked perfectly before the second battery was added was still no closer to working. What was more SolarEdge advised it was after the fact reneging on replacing the inverter under warranty.By now I’d have settled for returning the system back to the original as the installer and Solaredge didn’t seem to have a solution to fixing and neither seemed to want to fix the problem.I opened a SolarEdge case on their portal expressing extreme frustration. This was about 4 weeks after having no working system and getting charged higher electricity charges from the Amber wholesale market . No battery and I wasn’t shielded from price spikes.Another week and my case did jolt SolarEdge into doing something. It seems they sent out the wrong replacement inverter and now would replace it with a third under warranty.I’m still waiting for this third inverter to be delivered to the installer whereafter they have promised to come out and install and I hope restore the system. But my confidence in this being the outcome isn’t great but I’m really hoping it can’t get any worse…And to add salt into the wound, SolarEdge sent me the $500 cashback card which can’t be activated because it looks like it’s from some dodgy gift card company which can’t be contacted. This was a material inducement to why I invested in a second of their batteries.Overall to date a terrible experience.

STAY AWAY!!!!! I do not recommend this company to anyone, I have been a customer of 1Komma5 since April this year and regret my decision, they are appalling for customer service. They offer everything at the sale stage and when things go wrong they don’t want to deal with it.Please read the reviews and the experience of others with 1Komma5, I was promised that customer service had changed and went with them, I regret my decision.

Prior to the federal battery rebate, I received a quotation and promised  a price reduction based on the Federal battery rebate.After 1/7/2025, I contact the sales team and ask for a quotation revision. And the sales lady gave me the revised quote (with rebate) it was nowhere near the discussion and price promised (supposed to be 350$ approximately for per kwh).The new price provided to me (for 20kwh battery) is only about $1500 difference.When I approach the sales lady, she has no interest in explaining the breakdown and simply asked me if I would like to cancel the contract. A little upset however I hold no position to ask the sales person to revise the price which is only verbal.However the most upsetting part is the sales person soon blocked my number and is yet to give me any confirmation details of how I will get my deposit refunded.I realised my mobile number is blocked by the Sales person and have to call with a unknown number, which she never pickup. I have to call the head office to make a complain (through 2 to 3 different calls before I can get the refund.)This review is only to rate the certain sales's customer service and way of dealing with customer.I have not receive any product , so hence this is not a product review.

The quoting process was was good and the quote provided was accurate.The installation was quick and the team was punctual and friendly. Communication was good and was kept informed about start time. The site was left tidy.The after sales service is really lacking, I got a quote of $250 per hour to come and fix issues after the installation. The system does not feed into the grid, the energy retailer is point to installer and installer to retailer. No one is willing to help solve the issue.I am not getting any benefit from my installation.

Sales process: quick, they provided useful information and returned my queries promptly.Installation: punctual, tidied up after they finished the work, tried their best to hide the conduit and cabling, were careful not to damage thew roof tiles.Customer service: returned  queries promptly, took about 6 weeks to start feeding into the grid.

Easy process.The person who quoted and the one who followed up were able to answer all my questions and followed up well in the installation and operation.The installers were efficient but lacked some communication skills.The system installed meets every expectation.

Quoting process was very easy and informative. Everyone was so helpful explaining everything so we could understand what would be entailed. The installer was on time, the guys were lovely, polite, very efficient and left our premises clean an tidy. Customer service is great. Organised with our energy supplier for the installation of the smart meter, which has been done. All round we are very happy with our choice of solar installation suppler.

I had obtained many quotes from different suppliers as well as different t configurations. Eventually settled on 30 panels, inverter and battery for my house on 3phase supply.Got a full electrical switchboard upgrade in the process as I still had old fuses and all circuits were not protected.The install was done days after agreeing to terms and a team of 4 came to do both the switchboard work and the roof work. The work was delayed by rain so didn’t quite finish up on the Friday afternoon but a couple of guys returned on Saturday morning to job. They were all polite and helpful. There was a small problem where one of the panel arrays looked to be not generating anything but this was rectified when the installer returned and found a connector not quite pushed home far enough to positively lock into place.I was shown the basics around the shutdown startup process along with the supplemental signage in and around the switchboard and inverter.I was given access to the monitoring app to observe system performance.I found by accident that the wrong inverter profile was loaded as it was causing he inverter to switch to standby in the middle of the day at times but once this was corrected, the problem has gone away.Pretty satisfied.

The entire process was seamless, we received a great price and installation was completed 2 days after by a guy that has been in the profession for nearly 20 years and it certainly showed he did great quality work and everything was finished in approximately 4 hours. The system is working well, however we are still unable to connect our phone to the network which is frustrating. Ive made contact a few times requesting a call to walk me through the process but still no response, apart from that everything else was a breeze.

From start to finish, the process with 1KOMMA5 has been excellent – definitely a 10/10 experience.Graeme was outstanding throughout – always available, great with follow-ups, and super accommodating with calls on the fly.Brent and Daniel, the installers, went above and beyond – even removing an old satellite dish and taking it to be recycled. That kind of initiative really stood out.When our batteries didn’t kick in due to a tree over a powerline late on a Friday, I called at 5pm and was amazed at the support. Area Manager Tommy got me in touch with Brent again, and together we manually sorted the issue. I was genuinely impressed that they took the call after hours and stuck with it until it was resolved.To me, that shows 1KOMMA5 doesn’t just stop at installation – they’re in it for the long haul, with real support when you need it.Cheers,Jimmy

Komma5 sub contracts installation to Enviro energy. There was some issues with a missing component that was not in the installation kit. It took too long to sort that issue out. The people from Enviro energy were engaging and helpful. System now in and all is well.

Oct 2024 - The Salesperson & ordering process was efficient and followed up with a good value for money quote which I accepted for 25 Trina Solar panels and Tesla Powerwall3 battery. The Panels installed within first12 days of signing with the panel installers very good, quick & courteous.. Very happy with efficiency to this point.Tesla Powerwall3 installation was more challenging with delays and a lack of communication. Eventually battery installed  early December and working.Mid January Tesla Powerwall3 fails and so starts a lengthy process of seeking warranty work to fixed the problem.March 2025 - I finally have a replacement Tesla Powerwall3 installed and system is again functioning after 5 weeks.1KOMMA5 customer service and communication really needs to be improved.

The Sales/Quoting process was straightforward and the Salesperson was attentive and responsive to my questions.I did raise concerns about their mixed reviews, but was assured they would take care of me and that I could expect a seamless & stressless experience……after all they are the major supplier and installer of Powerwall in Australia, or so I was told.The installation was a nightmare. It dragged on for weeks, with dates and times being changed constantly and with very poor communication from both the Sydney based supplier and Newcastle based installer. There was a decided disconnect between the parties.I will spare the reader the lengthy list of issues and frustration I had to contend with. It was a diabolical experience…Apart from that the system appears to be working well now

Not great for warranty work when their product fails. I had a solar panel stop working in December in which the manufacturer diagnosed a faulty micro inverter and was sending a replacement one to 1komma5, who also had the details of the job. Since then they have not contacted me to organise to come and replace the faulty micro inverter, with the only correspondence being replies to my emails in which they say they dont have it or are looking into things. The manufacturer has provided me proof that they had it delivered to them on the 9th of January. They obviously do not want to back up their product with service and warranty work when faults happen.

We used 1Komma5 from a solarquotes recommendation, to install a 12.8kwh Sungrow battery and upgrade the inverter to a 6kw hybrid Sungrow inverter to our existing solar system.1Komma5 were great to deal with, no hard sell, all questions answered, great customer service.Install guys were great! Professional install, neat and tidy. really good job.

1Komma5, paid a Deposit last October 2024 for a Tesla Powerwall 2 and it's now February 2025 and it still hasn't been installed. At this stage I think we have lost our money. I don't really mind as long as I can let other people know how bad they are to deal with hopefully they won't have the dramas Im having with them.

The quoting was simple and efficient.The installers did a good job in very hot conditions. They were punctual, polite and tidy.The customer service was good up until the system was installed.The inverter tripped twice and stopped producing energy. I was unaware of this so there was a period of several days where we did not benefit from solar. I reset the CB on both occasions which fixed the issue for now. it took several phone calls and emails to get a response from 1Komma5 which was disappointing. It was over the Christmas break so I understand that people may not be available however communications need to be better. A service person came a couple of days ago to look at the problem but as yet I have had no response as to the cause of the problem which is concerning. Additionally, I should not have to check the app every day if the system stops generating energy - I should be alerted by a phone call or text message or some other method so I don't lose supply.
Courtney from; 1KOMMA5  customer service was fantastic, easy going with no question too small , polite, respectful, helpful , time bound and  organised.

-sales person was very good, i have asked for more batteries installation in the next few months!!-the installers did a fantastic, neat job and all were very courteous, did not leave until the job was thoroughly tested and working.

Fantastic sales service with all my questions answered and adjustments made as required. The process went quiet for a couple of weeks until I was contacted with an installation date. Everything was smooth from there with the installation proceeding on time and everything working as expected.

1KOMMA5 were great to deal with and were able  to install in the shortest time frame of the suppliers we engaged. They also price matched the cheapest of the quotes we had. Jordan on their sales team was particularly helpful and followed up right through to installation to ensure the timeframes we had stipulated were met by their service team.

Overall, they did a great job. During the process I was contacted by a number of different people in the company, which I found confusing. At the end of the day they did a great job and we are very happy.
Great experience all round. Good price. Very good service and install was quick and guys super friendly.Very Happy overall

Almost trouble free installation. The technician had to return the next day because the power wall needed to update itself and was taking a while.Returned the next morning as promised and completed the installation. System was explained to me. All very painless and professional.

End to end service was impeccable. Salesperson was helpful, communicative and knowledgeable. Installers were efficient and also highly communicative. No complaints, and since installation have basically taken no power from the grid. Very happy customer!

Greg (sales) from 1KOMMA5 Melbourne gave us a detailed , comprehensive quote with no hidden extras . Josh (installer) did a site visit as part of the quote process.The installation was scheduled and we were kept well informed. The team were friendly, punctual, polite and cleaned up after themselves leaving a neat job.We were helped to set up and shown how to use the Tesla app. They have organised future inspection andother approvals.

Initial installation date quick for solar panels but battery installation cancelled 3 times at the last minute, 4th time lucky they turned up and installed the battery efficiently but couldn't connect to the panels they installed as the were wired wrongly!! Only connected to our original panels.Also the only place for ours to go was in the garage, so should have had a metal pole installed in front of the battery for safety. So no pole and no connection as yet, I emailed today to inquire when this would be done and have had no reply as yet. Really not happy with the service. Unsure of size I got but put 10kw!

I initially had a good experience with 1Komma5 during the sales process as they scoped and rescoped a Powerwall 2 battery but after accepting the quote, paying the deposit and then full amount, it all went bad for weeks due to disorganisation, poor customer service and even now (4 months later) there's still something wrong they haven't rectified.Firstly, they kept on delaying and delaying the install date despite taking 100% of the money. We had 3 changes including complete no shows on the day. I had called them and asking what was going on the supposed day of install - they assured me they would get back to me but never did til 5:30pm (via email). They had sent an SMS the day before (which had gone to my spam folder) but I expected more than an SMS. The person responsible for the install experience never replied to my calls or emails.After 2 delays, they promised to install an EV charger for free on the install date.On the (actual) install date (which was a Friday), the hardware install all went smoothly and well, including the EV charger install. However it wasn't all working as a software update and some other things needed to happen before it all could go online. The install team would have to come back at some point - once again no promises when this would oocur but they would "try" to come the following week. I was pretty unimpressed.Thankfully they did come on the Monday afterwards (unannounced) and got it working.After they left, I noticed my carport lights were no longer working and I contacted the team to ask what happened, to which a ticket was logged but I'm yet to receive any word or fix. I'm going to have to pay my own electrician to fix it.Stay well away from this crew.

Sales and quoting were great v they understood our needs and constraints and optimised for us.Install was straightforward.They organised everything, including the new smart meter that we need to sell energy to the grid.

Quote and price very professional.Installation not as professional:First of all we were asked to supply photographs of where the power box was a where we wanted out Powerwall installed. I supplied several photographs and explained where I wanted it and why. No one called me back to discuss our installation requirement.When the installers arrived they said they had not seen the pix, no had told them anything. They went on to tell us we would have to have the PW2 in a different location because the cabling to where we wanted it would be too long. Why ask for the pix if you’re not going to use them?
Knowledgeable sales person, easy and fast installation, good service. Only hiccup was the Tesla battery software needed updating which delayed the set-up by 5 days, which was a bit frustrating.

It was my biggest mistake to go with this installer, they were so unprofessional that even a school kid would have done a better job.  They damaged the bathroom exhaust pip on the roof. they left the panel's cables exposed on the roof. See the attached pictures. they also drop one of the old panels from the roof on the pathway hedges and broke some of them. Hope you will not include this installer in your future recommendation to people. After many emails about the work, they finally send someone to fix the issues.

The sales/quoting process went smoothly and the sales team were easy to deal with and prompt with communication.When it came to installation, the organisation was frustrating - as it was a tenanted property and they were only offering dates with a couple of days notice. Once I got them to work directly with the tenants (which they had agreed to during the sales process) they were able to find a date that would work.On the installation date, the installation was not completed and we were not informed, which is a problem as their conditions are full payment on installation day. I found out through the tenants that the installation was not completed due to the installer not having the right parts. The installer (subcontracted) had not contacted 1KOMMA5 about the aborted installation. The installation was completed in their second visit on 1/7 (which I did need to follow up to confirm had taken place).As this was a Victorian installation, it needs to be independently inspected, which was promptly completed by 4/7.I received a 'final' package of documents on 19/7 via email which I thought meant everything was complete and ready for the tenants to add to their power bill.1KOMMA5 submit all the post-installation paperwork on the customer's behalf. On 29/7 I was informed that the tenants were not able to add solar to their power bill because the post installation paperwork had not yet gone through the correct channels. After following up a few times, 1KOMMA5 found an error in our address (which is feature of our property location - so that error is not their fault), and they resubmitted our paperwork to the electricity wholesaler on 2/8.On 20/8 I received notification that our paperwork had been approved by the electricity wholesaler. The tenants were able to successfully have solar added to their plan by 31/8. So the whole process from installation to adding solar to the electricity plan took approx. 2 months.At no point in the installation/connection process was any next step clearly explained - so I was constantly unsure what party I should hear from next and how long it would be expected to take. I also found that it was difficult to reach the installation and services teams via phone -  I got slightly better response rate via email than by leaving phone messages.The solar system seems to be working properly (from the monitoring apps) and there seem to not have been any technical problems to date.

I recently had a 6.64kw solar system installed on my home in Newcastle. I chose 1Komma5 as my supplier/installer. The whole process from the initial quote, to the installation went very smoothly without any problems for me. The staff in the office made themselves available to assist me at any time and were always very pleasant to deal with.On the day odf installation, the installers turned up on time, were pleasant and very professional about their work making sure that I was aware of what they were doing and was also shown how the system operated. They finished the installation in half a day and cleaned up any mess after they had finished.I have no hesitation in recommending 1Komma5 to any of my friends or family as a very professional,diligent and efficient solar provider and installer.

The entire process was smooth, efficient and professional. Quote provided promptly, followed by timely installation and post-installation service. The company responded to all queries promptly, and helped organise reconfiguration of meter by coordinating with my power supplier to integrate the solar system into the grid. Altogether a very satisfactory experience. 1KOMMA5 was not the cheapest, but overall, provided best value.

The sales process was responsive, informed and personal, easily the best we've experienced. Unfortunately, the critical issue of battery location was messed-up at pre-sale stage and led to difficult discussion with the install and support teams.  Pre-sale also failed to warn us regarding the known challenges of battery install when you are dealing with Box gutters, this led to more difficult discussions with install team.Overall, we are happy with the system performance and the client recovery undertaken to get us the best possibleoutcome. This could have been an all round 5 star review and a much smoother experience if pre sale was better equipped to accurately address known install issues and/or know when to refer to an installer for accurate information.

The sales man was knowledgeable and down to earth. It was over the phone, post initial online enquiry for quote. Sales man was knowledgeable, his relentless follow up calls to check in eventually eased my confusion to solar and the benefits of the right system.The installation process was easy but there were communication delays with office installations coordinator. They were not as efficient as the sales man.Installation overall went well, minor delays and a part missing for the hot water controller.The solar system installer was neat and communicated the system operation once installed. Having the self monitoring app is great, it’s learn as I go.Customer Service from 1Komma5 (formerly known as Solaray) can be improved. Customer follow up is quite poor, besides asking for a review. I hope to receive final documentation soon and once all my enquiries are resolved I will leave them a review.

I had an outstanding experience with 1KOMMA5 from start to finish. The entire process was incredibly easy, and the team was professional every step of the way. Their attention to detail and commitment to quality really stood out. I couldn’t be happier with the service provided and would highly recommend 1KOMMA5 to anyone looking for a reliable solar provider.

There were constraints to the inverter installation due to our Victorian era home. This meant we had to change to a micro inverter system which cost more but is good quality.1komma5 arranged the change quite efficiently and the day of installation went well. The installers were respectful and explained the system well.

After contacting a number of solar installers, who gave conflicting advice without site visits, ranging from 'not enough roof space' to 'too much overshadowing' (both wrong), I got 3 quotes and 1Komma5 was the best price. They all gave me lots of helpful information, but Gary from 1Komma5 was on my case from the start, followed through, and tried to provide the best solution for my roof panels. I was happy with the installation and using the Solaredge app for monitoring my solar production is a joy!

As normal the salesman was slightly pushy, but after the initial sales process we were handed to the coordination team which went smoothly with no problems.The sub contractor provided an update on the day of expected arrival and arrived on time!Installation team were professional as this was not a simple installation they asked questions to ensure I would be happy with the installed outcome. Installation was really neat and impressed with the outcome. Also being a electrician I was a bit dubious regarding companies using sub contractors as you cannot control the outcome in the quoting process. We could not be more happier with our decision to go with 1komma5.

The sales/quoting process was confusing. They were reluctant to do a site visit. I then found out they do not complete the installation but use a contractor. The contractor was helpful, tidy and punctual.Customer service was very poor. A number of people from the company were in contact, but did not actually do much. There were no instructions on how to use or make the most of the battery. Three weeks later I still do not have the final paperwork and do not know what the situation is with my energy supplier. My battery is working but not to its optimum.Not impressed with 1KOMMA5.

After a few major changes from the original quote, I decided to go ahead without a battery, which may be retro fitted later. Very good service from both Solaray and the installer. The original planned installation was delayed because of sickness of original installer.
All installers that got back to us were excellent. Straightforward comparisons made it easy to help decide what sort of system suited our budget. Tidy installation.

Sales quote was initially easy. However got a verbal add on which wasn't included on the quote. Then prior to installation they told me would install first then talk about the add on price after. Very time consuming to get an updated quote, intially they gave me outrageously expensive new quotes.Fast to arrive and install, no problems with installation or quality of the panels. On the day however, they told me they would install the charger another day.Main issue was with communication between the installation and sales team. Price ok. Quality seems good.

Arrived on time .Went through all the procedures straight away explaining where everything will be installed i.e battery placement ,cables and panels.Job completed on time and everything all setup and running by end of day.Very satisfied and so far have not encountered any faults.

Everything started fine - they met my price request, agreed to install in 1 week's time, turned up on time, then, in one day, they removed 2 old systems and installed 30 new panels, inverter and a Sungrow modular battery.  Since then, it's been all downhill from there.There was no commissioning of the system and no instruction of any kind other than to go online and find the iSolarCloud app. It turns out the inverter and the battery were wired incorrectly which, amongst other things, had excessive power being drawn from the grid and showed my house supplying power to the battery.  Also, after struggling to find, install and use the app without a user manual, I found that the app was faulty.1KOMMA5 answered my calls and emails and promised to look into the problems.  Twice they told me they had found a problem and were able to resolve it remotely but nothing had changed.  Their solution was to refer me to Sungrow to sort it out directly with them (which I refused).  After continually asking 1KOMMA5 for someone to come and check my system, they finally sent an Electrician one month after installation who discovered that the wiring had been totally botched and it took him most of the day to sort out.  This included selecting which circuits would be connected during backup mode which was not done originally.The sysyem now seems to be working properly as the power flows are going in the right directions and the grid usage is significantly lower.  However, it is now approaching 2 months since installation and I am still waiting to hear back about some issues with the battery performance and fixing the faults with the app.Of particular concern is that I have had to do all of the investigating to prove that specific problems existed with the system and with the app, and then spoon feed this research to 1KOMMA5 who have not shown any urgency to act.  I have given them 1 star for installation and for customer service only because this review process does not allow for a zero rating.

Solaray design was good and very competitively priced. We basically with discounts got a bigger system for the same price as other quotes. Good clear advice and easy to understand quote. No site visit unlike other quoters which can present issues later eg location of panels (you have to be there). But once deposit paid to Solaray not so good on the communications. Pre install team reach out and ask if you have any questions , which I did . Installation manager was meant to call but never did. So went back to design team who was helpful.Didn't know who installers were until they turned up on the day (was told it would be one company, turned out to be another - Platinum, who were great)Re: Platinum, Ahmed and his team were great. Good advice on where to put panels (different from design - this is the value of a site visit). Really nice work , cleaned up, great comms becuase they had to come back for a second day to finish. Seamless commissioning. Highly reccomend Ahmed and his team @ Platinum.Someone from Solaray came to check job before it was finished (but not after complete install) so had to sign off STC credits on that basis.These big companies (Solaray has just been bought out by a German private equity firm) use a lot of subbies to install - we got lucky with Platinum who were very professional. The benefit of the bigger companies is the purchasing power they can pass on to you and you get the latest technology.

The process with 1komma5 was excellent. Sales rep was knowledgeable and helpful. Local also which was great.The install team were great. Efficient and friendly.The prices for the equipment purchased appeared to be on par or better than others.

The Office team, Salesperson and Installation Team worked very efficiently. Quotation was over the phone as I knew exactly what I wanted. Yet, the Salesperson came home and made sure that I was happy with the quoted items. Installation was arranged within one week of loan approval by the bank. Installation was completed within 3 hours. It was done in a professional manner.I didn't have to do anything with AusGrid or Energy Supplier except signing and sending the forms provided to me and replying emails.

The sales quoting and installation process was to my expectations, prompt, knowledgeable and the installation team had all required expertise. I can recommend this company and their 3rd party installers.

The quoting process was excellent, the salesperson listened to my needs and designed a system to suit my complex roof design. Customer service was informative to the process, keeping in contact throughout and completing all the necessary paperwork.The installation team were punctual and completed the install with little disruption to my day, although they were a little messy.

Sales: I selected Solaray / 1komma5 because their sales team was able to factually answer my questions during their site visit - the other companies promised things that weren't actually possible (confirmed by inverter manufacturers).  I also liked that Solaray / 1komma5 is a large company who I expect will be around if there are any warranty issues down the track.Value for Money / Quality of System: I selected an Enphase system because it is inherently safer, provides panel level monitoring (which gives me more information/data if there is ever any warranty issues), and comes with a much longer warranty. My panels, racking, and inverters all come with 25-year warranties (I upgraded the inverter's standard 15 warranty for just a few hundred dollars more, and Solaray upgraded me to their premium black racking which has the higher warranty). Hopefully I won't have to worry about the system for many years to come.Installation: Solaray / 1komma5 use sub-contractors, which I was fine with - that is how most building work gets done in Australia.  Unfortunately, I appear to have been unlucky with the sub-contractor who came to install my system (I won't name names). Here is a list of issues that were detected by me and Solaray / 1komma5: Panels installed in wrong layout, insufficient feet used to secure panel racking to roof structure, roof tiles not grinded where feet are located, cables under panels not secured properly, cables in roof cavity not secured properly, sarking damaged by installers and not fixed, broken roof tile fixed with silicone rather than replacing with one of the spares, Enphase enclosure installed in wrong location, Enphase enclosure broken, 32A main circuit breaker installed in Enphase enclosure for 43A capable system, Enphase enclosure not labelled, no inverter supply switch installed in main switch board, labelling incorrectly applied to main switch board. The summary is that the system was not compliant with the CEC solar installation standards and multiple Australian electrical standards. The sub-contractor did return (a total of three site visits, two different installation teams) and fix some of the issues, but not all.  I even had to argue with them to install at least a 50A main circuit breaker in the Enphase enclosure - they said that a 40A breaker on a 43A system "should be okay".Customer Service: To Solaray's / 1komma5's credit, they arranged one of their own quality assurance staff to come and look at the system after I started pointing to the issues I found with the system, and they have now finally agreed to arrange a new sub-contractor to rectify and certify the system (hopefully that will happen soon). My only real gripes with Solaray / 1komma5 is that it has taken far too many emails to reach this position, and I didn't like the feeling of sometimes being caught between Solaray / 1komma5 and their sub-contractor - my contract is with Solaray / 1komma5 and I expect them to act on my behalf.

We decided to go with Solaray due to the thoughtful/expedient use of our existing system along with the abililty to add panels & a battery when the old system dies. Adam explained every aspect of the job and the whole team delivered efficiently and on time. I would highly recommend Solaray to anyone considering a solar system for their home.

The company quoted promptly and favourably price-wise, modifies the quote in line with my further requirements.The installers arrived early in the morning as promised and finished the job of installing inverter and 28 panels (12kW) in about 8 hoursWe are still working through the commissioning process with Solaray which may be for an extended period - two more weeks, perhaps - since the house build is as yet incomplete and we are unable to occupy it. The Solaray staff have been very diligent during the post installation phase.We chose not to install a battery at this time.

The initial install and operation was good, and I even received some great support. Unfortunately, they seem to have dropped the ball since then. I've had a fault where most of the micro-inverters have stopped responding. After lodging the support request, Enphase shipped replacement micro-inverters directly to me, and I've been battling for over 2 years to get Solaray to swap them over. They, most recently, have told me that there's nothing more they can do, and I should contact Enphase. This is nonsense, since Solaray sold, supplied, and installed the system. The warranty responsibility is with them. Enphase have already done their part by providing replacement units. I just need an installer/electrician to swap them over.

The whole process went quite smoothly and surprisingly quickly.  One minor hiccup was easily resolved.My main concern is that I'm not sure that I got the best positioning of panels on my roof - but then I'm not sure I didn't either.  The north-facing panels definitely produce more energy, and I think there is room for another one.  But maybe the west-facing panels will do better in summer...And I'm not sure how much I should be concerned about the shade of various trees - particularly later in the afternoon.I should have asked more about "why did you choose that arrangement of panels".  I was given the opportunity, but didn't think to ask.

The quoting process was prompt and thorough in their support.Installation crew arrived on time, explained process and met my requirements without question.The installation was replacing a smaller system so there was no issues with grid connection.After Sales support was also tested and helpful.
All went well with the installation.. just waiting to get connected to the grid

Solar panels will be installed on Monday, 22 May as roof renovation was completed 2 weeks ago.  We are so appreciative on SolarQuotes for giving us a very informative website that was a great help in our decision to select what we believe was a quality solar package.Keep on the good job, Finn Peacock.
Were supposed to turn up at 8am, turned up at 12.30pm, ended up rushing and finished in total darkness so any instructions were v casual and perfunctory.
Good customer service with great communication. Installers were prompt , polite, and cleaned up all their mess. Would strongly recommend

A recent installation so too early to tell how well the system will work medium to long term.I wanted to have the tile roof repainted between installing the feet (for the rails) and completion and Solaray were accommodating with the two visits. All cabling was done precisely and with minimal conduit showing - just a bit from the meter box to the Enphase Envoy gateway.Overall I’m very happy with my choice of Solaray, the REC panels / Enphase IQ7A microinverters and the installation by Top Power Electical.

Everything was handled professionally, there was no pressure put on me to sign up. They answered all my questions and were extremely helpful.The wait for installation was only a week and the installation process was done in a day. They consulted with me at all times and did a great job. The battery was installed 2 weeks later and was again an easy process.They did all the paperwork and coordinated with the energy supplier for the connection to the grid and installation of a new meter.They responded promptly to my follow up questions.I would have no hesitation in recommending them.

After several low quality quotes from less than quality installers we were so happy to have found Adam and the team at Solaray.  Firstly he gave an amazing explanation of all the different systems and differentiation between other provider quotes.  The poor person really does pay twice in the solar game so buy a quality system first time and get it right.  Installation was done by two Qualified and regeistered Solar electricians which was great. Quality install of all the support member and panels align perfectly and no leaks!!!We went with the enphase micro inverter system. Best move ever. Yes it cost a lot more but well worth it as we produce solar over a longer period (get Adam to explain it). Also you’re connected to a real time app, so you can adjust your consumption throughout the day.We opted for a “bright loan” which meant we didn’t have to worry about huge upfront costs.Just so happy we went with the pros on this one and bought quality that will last 20years plus.Thanks again.

I was bit worried about getting my first solar system with all the horror stories you hear. So after doing my research I came up with Solaray and went ahead and filled in all the details for a quote. I was then contacted by Adam Remigio who talked me through all the options and we settled on what I needed. After a few days of me thinking about it I called Adam and he walked me through all the things I needed to do to make the process run smoothly. Every thing went the way Adam had advised, the installers where also great and installed the panels and the Tesla Power wall without a hitch. I had seen a lot of other solar installation and I was surprised and how neat it all looked

Adam was fantastic no pressure at all very knowledgeable listend to what we want from our solar and the type of system and advise us of the best panels that would suit our budget as we had already decided on the Enphase system18 x REC Twin Peak 5 Black 400W Panels (7.20 kWp) with 18 x Enphase IQ7A Microinverters and Envoy MonitorThe installer Dan and his team did a fantastic job very neat and clean and very professional and punctual. Great job solaray if I could I would give them 11 out of 10.

From my initial contact with Solaray, through to confirmation of order through to installation I have been totally impressed by the whole process. I was provided comprehensive analysis of my current energy consumption and analysis of potential usage as I transition towards a greener lifestyle. I had a detailed assessment of my property and was provided with the optimal system for my property - including its heritage and planning limitations.The order was completed and installed 1 week early. The selected installer was fantastic. They were punctual, respectful, trustworthy and tidy. They also kept me informed as to the installation process as it went along. I could not have asked for more.The site visit to arrange sign off of the installation was rapid, and my system has just started running. It is great to see so rapidly, that I am decreasing my reliance on the grid, and that I am making a real difference to my own power usage, but also my contribution to the environment. This would not have been possible without the expert guidance processing and planning by everyone at Solaray. Thank you everyone for a job not only well done, but expertly done.

I was super impressed with Solaray's comprehensive quote, I was surprised when it was all done online (no onsite inspection) but they were very comprehensive and ensured I had the best panel placement. Installers were fast and did a great job.

The sales person seemed helpful and followed up. I guess that's their job.They did a lot of work to help me get ready for the installation. Specifically helping to upgrade the meter box although I did get that done by the solar installer.  Again, I can see they wanted to get the installation done.The did help with the grid connection although after the installation the meter was going backwards and although this seemed like a good thing for me I knew logically it was wrong (because I was getting a feed-in tariff equal to my peak purchase rate) and in the end I think it was a disadvantage.Since it's all been operational, I am disappointed with the lack of responsiveness and resolution to a problem I have where the Enphase monitoring and power retailer data disagree. It seems like a minor issue but my confidence in the usage monitoring/reporting system is dropping.  Even a more minor issue that is less important is the usage graph provided - which mathematically I think is just wrong in a couple of places.

I recently hired this solar installer company to install solar panels on my roof and I have to say, I was extremely impressed with their services.First of all, they were incredibly punctual. They arrived at my house at the exact time that we had scheduled the appointment for and they were ready to get to work right away. I appreciated this because I have a busy schedule.Secondly, they were very tidy. Lee and his team took great care to ensure that their work area was clean and organized throughout the entire installation process. They were also very respectful of my property and made sure to protect it from any potential damage.Lastly, their attention to detail was impeccable. Adam went above and beyond to ensure that the installation was done correctly and that I was completely satisfied with the end result. He also took the time to explain everything to me in detail (more than once) and answer all of my questions.Overall, I would highly recommend this solar installer company to anyone looking to install solar panels on their home or business. They were punctual, tidy, and detailed, and their level of professionalism was unmatched. I am very satisfied with the work they did and would not hesitate to use them again in the future.

Has my 9KW solar system now installed since mid-Nov 2022 and whilst I was generally happy with the sales and installation process, Solaray have certainly dropped the ball when it comes to post sales support. Ever since the system was activated and connected to the grid, the panel performance has failed to live up to expectations. Far from the average daily energy output of 45kw that was suggested, I am averaging much less than half of that. There are often times during the day when some or all panels are in error.Attempting to chase this up with Solaray has been a frustrating process. I have been told everything from this is normal, to it must be something to do with the grid (electricity company called out and reported no issues) and then when I kept on chasing they said they would do some further testing and probably a site visit. That was 3 weeks ago and I still don't have any update.

Solar installation is still not fully complete as I am still waiting for the installation of a smart meter.The sales/quoting process was good, and the installation went smoothly. They also helped me to apply for grid connection for which I am still waiting.

Process was very smooth from quote request through to installation. Our installer was awesome: he was polite, hard working (and his apprentice too), diligent, efficient and communicated the process really well throughout!

Professional and efficient business. Clear explanations and walk you through each stage. Panels put in yesterday so to early for me to comment on how well the system works until the final setup is complete

This company started with discovering our energy needs re how we use apliances, number of household members etc. rather than trying to sell us a system to get the most profit for themselves. They were also courteous and kept us thoroughly informed every step of the way. Felt free to phone and ask any question, which was always answered clearly. System working perfectly. V. pleased with Enphase mini inverters.

Solaray provided great information, customer service and a quality, high performing system with easy app for monitoring. Pre sale information, quoting process , installation and follow up all top shelf. Prompt installation too. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.review_description: Great sales and support team. Installer was very friendly and informative. Great all round experience.

After 14 years service from our old 2008 2Kw system, we decided to upgrade to a larger & more efficient system.  Only 1 provider, Solaray, contacted us, &, as the plan is to add a battery at a later time, suggested we go for an 8.3Kw system which was the largest our roof could take.  Their quote was about what we were expecting, so we went ahead & purchased from them. We could not have been happier with Solaray.  they kept us updated with what was happening, & a week after we payed the deposit, had an installation team booked.The install went without a hitch despite them being a man down with Illness.  The old system was removed, the new frames & panels installed & all hooked up to the grid by Midday, with the breakage of just one roof tile.  By that evening we had already generated 19 Kw of Electricity, the best our old system ever did was 12Kw all day in the middle of Summer. (Back when Summers were dry & sunny).Customer service was very good, I only had one issue with not receiving the log in for the Enphase App,  which actually had to come from Enphase themselves.  Within an hour of calling I was emailed the details.  I'd call that a 5 star service.
Very smooth process, managed expectationsand installed on time.  Post install support also very good.

After much muddling around, we took the Solar Plunge!We received a number of quotes, sought advice and asked lots of questions, and finally decided on Solaray.The sales and quoting process was reasonably easy. It is disconcerting when, while seeking information from a variety of sources, conflicting information is received. Solaray guided us through the information, and we agreed on a price, installation time, installation appearance, and the array design.The price was quite reasonable, given that we decided on a slightly more expensive (efficient) solar panel.Confusion about microinverters was sorted out and agreed upon.The installation was not as “invisible” as I had hoped. Instead of secreting the wiring in the wall cavity, as done in neighbouring houses, there is conduit running up the outside of the house. This is a small inconvenience, in the scope of things.The array design is not as described in the agreement. Laying panels over “stink” pipes concerned me. After a period of discussion, a new design was agreed.Solaray were very helpful getting me re-connected to the grid, with my new Smart Meter.The solar panels are now in place, and I feel as though I am doing my bit to delay the catastrophe of Climate Change.

Great project management / communication from the sales phase to post installation. Provided advice during the sales phase. Fast installation date post sales. Allowed to changed the installation date few times to allow me to get the loan approved. Customer service kept me well informed throughout the process.

Patrick was very patient with my never ending questions and explained everything well.The installers were great - showed up on time, did a great job, and tidied up afterwards. They explained what they were doing and how the system worked.Post installation customer service has been great. They arranged our new meters with through the supplier
Lots of pressure to decide from all of them.Install went well apart from lack of Safety gear, and HRA.Grid connection done, waiting on Meters this week

I knew of Solaray already through family and neighbours. They were relativley a local supplier.  Solaray was quick to respond to my inquiry by email and then a phone call a day later. They had the components that I had previously researched were probably the best on the market. They installed in about three weeks. Customer service was pretty good and the installation team arrived on the due date. They did all the paperwork on completion.As of today, they are the only ones I would recommend.P W -Baulkham Hills

Customer service was great before and after install. Before the installation I requested some changes in system size and panel layout, the sales person was more than happy to work through several iterations before I landed on one.I was very impressed with the quality of the installation. On time,  nice and neat, my roof does not leak after several large rain events and the panels have been installed in the exact locations I wanted.The Trina Vertex S+ seem to be doing a great job in both cloudy and sunny days. Very impressed with the power output on sunny days, they seem to be a great pairing with the Enphase inverters.

The rep was easy to deal with, and happy to look at various options I was considering.  Our install wasn’t straightforward and they were happy to go the extra mile to avoid conduit being visible.  System is working well.
Everything went smoothly from quote to installation. Well recommended solar products and installer!

Overall, very happy with how the 6.63kW system is performing to date and have recommended them to family members that are thinking of getting solar installed as well.You pay for what you get and i wanted either an optimised Solaredge or an Enphase micro inverter set up so it was going to cost more than a cheaper set up.The final price of the Solaray system was about $400-$500 cheaper than the next best quote which included a Modbus consumption meter as well and i made sure all the panel brands and models were the same where possible so it was like for like.From October 2021 to January 2022, the lowest daily production day has been 8-9 kWh on dark heavy rainy days and the maximum production day has been 44-45 kWh on the hot and sunny days. Not sure if this is good or bad figures.After requesting 3 quotes from Solarquotes, Solaray contacted me the next business day to discuss specs and what i was looking for.The 2nd company didn't bother to give me a quote until SolarQuotes followed up with me a week later, but by then i had already got ~7 quotes so told them not to bother.The 3rd company asked me what i wanted, but just tried to sell me a larger system than i wanted and didn't give me a quote for the brands or system size that i wanted.Lisa from Solaray was very helpful, listened to what i wanted and explained the differences between the systems quoted and answered my questions in a friendly and timely manner and didn't pressure me or rush me to go ahead and gave me multiple budget/brand options to suit me.Due to living in a strata complex, I was told by Tammy in their installation team that apart from a new smart meter, i also needed to have a MPD installed by a level 2 electrician which couldn't be done by Origin for free and would need to pay Ausgrid.I paid Solaray's electrician $605 to install this first because i would end up paying someone else a few weeks after the installation was complete anyway, so this expedited the whole process once installation was complete and they sent and organised all the paperwork with Origin.Their installation team came out to inspect the site 2 weeks or so before installation day and confirmed where the panels would need to be installed and that my inverter may need to be installed outside due to the garage walls being gyprock/plasterboard and no extra costs required and it was all ok to go ahead.The installers came out around 7.30am and completed the installation in about 4-5 hours. They managed to find the support beams behind the garage walls to mount the inverter inside the garage after all which was a great result. They had to run some conduit down the wall and couldn't hide it behind that walls. They cleaned up after themselves and there wasn't any mess for me to clean up or deal with.I cant see up on the roof, so i don't know if they broke any tiles or not, but since installation there have been a few days of heavy rain and i haven't seen any water leaking into the house so it looks like it's all good so far.As soon as installation was complete, i was generating solar to power my house since the smart meter was already installed and selling back excess solar to the grid that same afternoon.I got all the warranty paperwork and final invoice from Deb about 4-5 weeks later.I got my Solaredge app login details the next business day and it was then i could see they forgot to install the modbus consumption meter as i couldn't see any self/grid consumption or export to grid and only my daily production.This part was frustrating as there was several back and forth follow ups by me, cancelled appointments by them, damaged parts and then further shipping delays and took 3 months for them to come back and install the modbus and complete the installation.I note the system was working great and producing solar perfectly since it was installed and it was just i couldn't see my self consumption and grid consumption.Once it was installed, my system stopped producing solar for the rest of the day for some weird unknown reason and didn't start working again until the next day once the inverter restarted the next morning. The installer said he had to upgrade firmware/software in the inverter so that may be the cause.Now it's all working properly again, i can see how much i am selling back to the grid and consuming from the grid. I can compare it to my daily usage with Origin app to see if my bills are accurate vs how accurate the Solaredge app is and am very happy with how things are looking and working.Thanks to Solaray for their help and the great system.

Sales/quoting process was very good. Installation was impacted by the period of bad weather in Sydney in July but otherwise was ok. Assistance has been provided with respect to the grid connection. All up, would recommend Solaray as a good supplier.

The quotation process was seamless, the sales staff were very reactive to my changes.Very helpful information provided in the quotation about the components.Very good guarantees for the panels etc.After the inspection visit the installation was three weeks later and took two days. 33 panels and microinverters.Very professional installers who were very punctual, polite and tidy.The firmware for the micro inverters were updated immediately after installation from Solaray.Customer service also organised the new meter install which was done in two hours.The system is performing better than expected so we are very happy.We will next be looking at batteries for storage.
Great service from start to finish. Answered all of my questions. Installed and working within a week of getting the quote. So far working well.

Solaray were professional and very helpful, they kept in contact throughout  the entire process. Once we selected our system the sales and install teams were fantastic and super quick. Very happy with Qcells and Enphase microinverter with consumer monitoring.Great follow up service, they organised the powerboard upgrade and grid connection after installation.System generates solar even on cloudy days!!

GreatAll of the above was fine.A bit of concern, head office sent me warranty documentations with a link but that didn't link, I also asked forSystem performance estimateArray frame or racking engineering certificate (proves mechanical safetyBut nobody has bothered replying.
As above. A very professional company to deal with from start to finish.

Solaray did a great job in the installation of our solar system. They kept us in the loop at all times, easy step by step process. Would highly recommend them. All staff were polite and very professional.we’ll done!

The quote was exactly what I asked for and was then quickly adjusted when I provided more details. The layout and detail made it easy to assess. When I signed up the installation was arranged very quickly and went smoothly. The first few days have produced power at about the level I was expecting so I am very happy. The paperwork process for the rebate, the meter upgrade and the grid connection was handled by Solaray and so far everything has gone very smoothly.
Once i decided to go with this particular system, Solarray was very efficient with good communication.The installation was straightforward and very well executed.2 years on everything is as expected.

Sales team were very knowledgeable and helpful, gave good information and open to me undertaking my own research after discussing with them on the system options.Uses enphase app to track and manage your power, so I can see busy times of day and adjust activity accordingly.Installation was delayed several months as they hadn't worked on my type of roof, and didn't know how to do it and I had to chase to get updates. Over promise and under deliver.When they finally arrived to do the job, they were quick to install and helpful to walk through setup.Unfortunately since installation I have had several leaks during rain events as a result of the way the brackets were installed on the tiles. Solarey is not taking responsibility for them and  no roofer will touch the panels.Poor after sales/ installation service.

Quoting process was good however there was a glitch that the installer picked up. Photo included with quote was not our house and if it had been followed panels would have been installed on the wrong side of the roof.

Dealt with 3 great installers but in the end Solaray Offered the best system for the best price.All 3 installers gave an estimate of around 4 weeks for system install but in the end the install took place just over 2 weeks from deciding on Solaray. The installation went smoothly and the installers turned up on time and were great.Solaray followed up post installation and the system has been been performing brilliantly.
The whole process from start to finish was no fuss, with great follow up afterwards

Excellent sales and quoting person. Happy to discuss and refine options and redo quotes till we reached agreement on size, product and panel layout to maximise energy generation.After such detailed analysis, followed by pre-install site check, it was most disappointing that the installer changed the layout on install day without discussing with us. Since we can’t see our roof from the ground we were unaware of this until after installation.Beware folks: on install day CHECK WITH THE INSTALLER that the installer intends to stick to the agreed layout!We understand that installers need to have some leeway, but the sticking point for us was not being consulted about the changes, and the company rep we then emailed downplaying the importance of this, before then offering a basic apology. This could be an isolated incident - I hope so - but indicated total lack of respect for us as customers.Install was only yesterday, so feeling pretty raw.
Friendly easy quoteInstallation simply doneCustomer service = punctual, helpful, friendly and informative

Solaray made it easy for me from the beginning. No pressure to buy, gave me an option of solar panel brands and were happy to suit my budget. Look forward to upgrading my system with them in the future.

Solaray was easy to deal with from the start. They provided quotes, answered all my questions and generally very easy to communicate with.The installation was great and everyone involved were efficient. They installers were punctual, respectful, quick and left the place spotless.The company also followed up straight away to help ensure our meter was updated remotely to get the system up and running as quick as possible. Can not fault them. Highly recommended!

Initial consultation very comprehensive, sales person very keen to help.  Expensive but you get what you pay for, the installation generally went smoothly, however, there was a misunderstanding between the installers and the office team regarding the placement of some panels, requiring a second rectifying visit.  The installers arrived on time, were very clean and removed all rubbish. The system was completed and functioned perfectly from completion. The grid connection has been organised and we have subsequently been contacted to arrange the installation of a new meter.The second company we were given to contact failed to contact us until we had been talking with the successful company for more than a week.  We took this to mean they were either too busy or not keen on the job.  We have an 8kW system with Powerwall 2 battery.
Informative, accurateInstallation was brilliant and efficientI did have to initiate consultation after installation but was happy with the response after.

All dealings with Solaray have been easy and efficient - they have made the whole process so much easier for me combined that with your service of narrowing down to good suppliers really helped so thank you very much - very happy the last piece of the installation is happening today and then I am SOLAR happy.

We are happy with Solaray. The advice and quote process was sensible, without the exaggerated claims we met with other companies. The fact that they sent the final installation company for a site visit was important to us. The installation went very smoothly and we we are having fun watching our consumption and production on the app.

Very happy with Solarquotes, they really helped me make a good choice, by explaining the pitfalls and what to look out for.My selected installer was excellent, from quote to installation and organising the grid connection, plus further support offered.
Quote prompt and well presented.Installation punctual and efficient.Grid connection organised following installation. Service calls until we were satisfied.

Solar Quotes arranged two quotes from recommended solar companies. Solaray was one of the companies who responded and explained various options and costings. Quoted a greatly discounted price for a premium system which I accepted. System was quickly and very professionally installed. Great customer service during the process and follow up following installation. Highly recomend Solar Quotes and Solaray.
All involved both in the office and on site have been polite and professional.
Fantastic service, quality products at a reasonable price. Installer was great very helpful

The sales quoting process was very straightforward, clear and competitive.The installation was perfectly smooth, punctual, very careful (I was worried with my tiled roof), tidy and organisedAfter sales service is excellent, you always have someone there to ask for anything unclear.  They are friendly and keep looking after you.

Sales Quoting process was easy and provided high level of detail.Installation was done in 3/4 of a day. Punctual, worked hard, Very neat and tidy and wanted perfection for installation on cabling, Conduits, circuit breakers, Battery.
Good customer service. The installation process was very prompt and smooth.

Solaray quoted well, but were not quite as competitive as I had wanted, so over a few days we moved around on price until I was happy to go ahead with them.Installation was carried out well, and the lead installer did a good job of keeping me informed. The electrical box was well placed.The arrangements for the installation were very good, and I was kept well informed by the friendly team. On completion of the job they also triggered the replacement of the meter.All in all, so far, I'm very happy I picked Solaray. (And I also chose them due to two very good recommendations from friends.)
The coordination was excellent (allowed me to have a tiler on board on the day to replace roof tiles) plus the quality of he work was excellent - much neater than my original system.

Extremely helpful answering all my questions before and after install. I kept calling as I thought of more questions, but nothing was a problem for them. Very impressed with their professionalism and thoroughness.Install was very professional and polite.

It was a smooth process since the quotation stage. Installation booked in a short period of time and done on the day scheduled. Removed and recycled existing solar system with no extra cost. System works fine over a month now. Called the company back only once for data connection drop-out that was easy to re-connect it. Would go with them if installing again. Owners should pay attention to available feed-in tariff plans if going over 10 kW and best panel layout.

They discussed what I wanted without a preconceived product that they wanted to sell and advised on the basis of what I asked for.  Other companies that I spoke to were either hard sell or inflexible.Installation was "no fuss" quick and clean.The company has arranged the new meter to be fitted next week.Overall performance is too early to tell.Heard wonderful stories about the product of the other quoters but research did not stack up.
Powerwall install -Product needs no selling- good price, good communication, great tidy install and nice  people in general. I'll use them  for my second array
Quotation was fast, sales person helpful. Installation team excellent and work tidy. Change of meter  and grid connection all organised by Solaray. So happy with everything. Highly recommended.
Excellent so far. Install was neat and team were super helpful. Solar ray have been excellent and in contact with me through the whole process. Install team did a very neat and tidy job. Very happy.

The sales/quoting process was straight forward. The system was installed a few days after I made a deposit. My initial questions regarding the some of the panels power output were explained thoroughly. The grid connection was organized by the installer as well.

The sales and quoting process was comprehensive and very professional. They were good enough to vary the quote a few times while I decided on the best size to install. The installers themselves were efficient and helpful. The follow up service successfully organised my new smart metre which is coming tomorrow.

Sales: Pleasant to deal withPrice: Provided most competitive figuresInstallation: Was quick and had no issue at allSystem: It has been running perfect so farAfter Service: Helped me with meter upgrade and provided helpline in case anything is neededOverall: Very satisfied with level of service and productNeg: Sales wasn't too clear about what kind of monitoring system is included

The 3phase system was installed within 5 days of acceptance as fortunately we didn't have to change the 3phase meter. The systems been generating in excess of 30Kwh a day pretty much ever since in the middle of winter and a very sub-optimal roof layout.A very neat installation with all wiring are behind the house facade -meaning no exposed conduit!SolarRay followed up on a query within an hour and it was resolved within 2 hours. SO good service.
Everything was done very well and punctual.No hassles and have really  helped in organising the smart solar meter replacement.

Supremely professional, prompt, polite, they did what they said they'd do in the given time frame.We even had our own project manager whom we are STILL contacting and getting assistance! I highly recommend Solaray and their team! Thanks heaps Finn!! And Solaray!!

It is only a matter of a few weeks since our panels were installed so a bit early for an in-depth review.So far we are very happy. All the people we spoke to who were connected with this company were polite and friendly and knew their job; in particular, Patrick Smith, their sales guy, who we spoke to several times before our decision. His knowlege and patience was a key deciding factor.
No hard sell just facts and options , installers were on time polite and efficient. Customer Service organised to the grid connection after the install.
Good customer service and efficent installHead installer new his stuff

The sales person was brilliant! The web generated quotes were super detailed and clear. They were true to their word at ever step of the way. We had a range of quotes from Solaray but after the site visit the sales person generated another quote, the one we eventually selected. The installation team were brilliant, hard working and so courteous, but they did leave a few things that needed fixing but Solaray arranged that to be done and it was to my satisfaction. The only negative was getting the meter changed, I should not have started to change energy supplier just before the solar install, as the change over was going to take over three months! The rail system to mount the panels isn't flexible enough to adjust the panel position relative to the purlins. Our panels jut above the ridge line when there is plenty of space for them to be neatly flush or just below. This is why the installation only got a "good" rating.The power output peaks at 2.7kW. Yet there are 10 LG 320N panels rated at 320 watts. The sun angle at the ideal time of day is currently less than 10 degrees off being perpendicular to the panels. So the real world performance of the system is about 15% less than it's claimed performance. Thus rating for quality of system only gets a "good".The system uses Enphase micro inverters and tracks the performance of each panel. There are other systems which produce similar power for less money, so the system is not the "best" value for money, but is still very good. We preferred the AC coupled arrangement so that we can add additional panels in the future which may face other directions and were prepared to pay a little extra for this ability.

I got what I paid for basically. I bought a cheaper system - composed of  Renesola panels and Schneider  GT2.8 inverter.On the first day, I was getting 2800Watts from direct northwest sunlight. On subsequent days, only getting 2400Watts.Five weeks since the installation, the max it can produce is 2400Watts out of a 3000Watts system.The inverter was manufactured in 2011 - which is 4-5 yrs old on the day of installation.The thing I learned about solar power (PROSPECTIVE BUYERS TAKE NOTE).Solar installers will insist that the panels be installed and oriented to the direction to catch the maximum amount of sunlight.(This is also in accordance with the sales pitch).In reality, you can only maximise the benefit and return of your investment in solar power if your power usage coincides with the solar power production. ie. It's no good in saying the system can give you certain amount of watts during peak sunlight (eg 11am to 3pm panels facing northwest), if you aren't using it.Normal  residential power usage peaks in the morning and in the evening. Ideally, half of the panels should be oriented facing northeast and the other half facing northwest.
